topic: FC (EA FC) match recreation parody where AI/voiced Ronaldo, Yamal, Messi and Vozinha play together, comedy about Yamal being traumatised by Vozinha
hook: Top-down FC game midfield view with 3 face-cam insets (Ronaldo, Yamal, Vozinha) top-right
subtitle_style: Game UI only; no added subs in sampled frames; names in small caption on insets
reaction_overlays: Face-cam style inset portraits with coloured gaming headsets (Ronaldo red, Yamal pink, Vozinha blue, Messi), cycling top-right; green EA broadcast HUD
transition_summary: Mostly continuous gameplay with very few cuts (one cut detected at 70 s); only camera-angle changes and a replay cutscene near 56-62 s
audio_note: AI voice dialogue (disclaimer in series) plus game audio; transcript: Can the goat and Vozinha stop Yamal from scoring...

reuse_segments.what: EA FC gameplay with character insets
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: own recorded gameplay; character portraits need cleared/AI-generated art
